title: Design System: ASCA Ink System
source: Extensions only. Token primitives live in docs/02-design/DESIGN.md frontmatter (v2.0.0-alpha); this file was generated from app/globals.css, components/ui/button.tsx, components/layout/page-hero.css and components/apply/apply.css without editing DESIGN.md.

display-lg.purpose: Page hero titles (PageHero .asca-ph__title, weight 600, line-height 1.05, -0.02em, keep-all, balanced).

headline-lg.purpose: Section heads (ApplySectionHead) on serif display face.

title-lg.purpose: Card and list titles on Pretendard.

body-md.purpose: Korean body copy; reading pages narrow to --shell-narrow (50rem) and --measure (40rem).

shadows.name: xs
shadows.purpose: Resting cards and inputs. Navy-tinted, never neutral black.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Default transitions (globals.css; DESIGN.md says 260ms, see drift report).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Lifting the brush: entrances and hovers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One main call to action per area. Navy ink on paper text, 6px corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #0b1733; color: #fbf8ef; font: 500 14px/1 Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(11 23 51 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fbf8ef, 0 0 0 4px #c89729; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary. Warm input border, gold wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #d9d3bf; border-radius: 4px; background: #fbf8ef; color: #0b1733; font: 500 14px/1 Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #d4a84a; color: #0b1733; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fbf8ef, 0 0 0 4px #c89729; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Dense rows and icon buttons. Never on heroes.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #0b1733; font: 500 14px/1 Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #d4a84a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #c89729; }

components.name: Page Hero
components.description: Signature page opener: vertical Traditional-Chinese mark with a seal-red square, crumbs, serif title on the shell frame.
components.html:
公募

印
  1. 홈
  2. 공모전

제23회 대한민국 동양서예대전

서울서예박물관 두 전시실에서, 공모전과 書境 초대작가전을 한 흐름으로 엽니다.
components.css: .ds-ph { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: clamp(24px, 4vw, 64px); align-items: end; padding: 64px clamp(1.25rem, 10vw - 3.5rem, 8rem); background: #fbf8ef; color: #0b1733; } .ds-ph__mark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-ph__tc { margin: 0; writing-mode: vertical-rl; font: 600 28px/1 'Noto Serif TC', serif; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #a77d24; } .ds-ph__seal { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 2px; background: #a8201a; color: #fbf8ef; font: 600 14px/1 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-ph__crumbs { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 20px; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: 13px; color: #424a5e; } .ds-ph__title { margin: 0; font: 600 clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.75rem)/1.05 'Playfair Display', 'Noto Serif KR', serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; word-break: keep-all; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-ph__lede { margin: 16px 0 0; max-width: 40rem; color: #424a5e; font: 400 18px/1.6 Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; }

components.name: Ledger Table
components.description: Schedules, fees and edition records as a ruled ledger; the lead row is emphasized.
components.css: .ds-ledger { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #0b1733; font: 400 15px/1.5 Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; } .ds-ledger caption { text-align: left; padding-bottom: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: #424a5e; } .ds-ledger th { text-align: left; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #0b1733; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #424a5e; } .ds-ledger td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e0ce; } .ds-ledger tr.is-lead td { font-weight: 600; background: #f4efdd; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White card on paper, warm border, 6px corners, navy-tinted resting shadow.
components.html:
書境 초대작가전

협회 초대작가는 공모 부문이 아니라 초대작가전으로 출품합니다.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e5e0ce; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #0b1733; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 hsl(222 54% 8% / 0.08); transition: box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -4px hsl(222 54% 8% / 0.12), 0 4px 8px -2px hsl(222 54% 8% / 0.08); } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 20px/1.3 'Playfair Display', 'Noto Serif KR', serif; } .ds-card__body { margin: 0; color: #424a5e; font: 400 15px/1.6 Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Warm input border on paper; gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 280px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #d9d3bf; border-radius: 4px; background: #fbf8ef; color: #0b1733; font: 400 14px/1.4 Pretendard, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7385; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fbf8ef, 0 0 0 4px #c89729; }

narrative.overview: See docs/02-design/DESIGN.md §1 Overview. Navy ink and true gold on rice paper; seal red only for seals and errors.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-900 ink on rice paper; gold is surface and ring, never text
Seal red 朱印 reserved for seal marks and errors
Serif display (Playfair Display + Noto Serif KR) over Pretendard body
Shell frame: 1200px body, proportional gutters shared by header, hero, body and footer

rules.name: The Gold Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: Gold (#d4a84a) is a surface, accent and ring color; do not set text in it (DESIGN.md §2.1.2).

rules.name: The Seal Only Rule
rules.body: Seal red appears only on seal marks and error/destructive states.

rules.name: The Semantic Slot Rule
rules.body: New code uses semantic slots (bg-primary, bg-accent, text-muted-foreground). Legacy names like celadon-green and scholar-red are kept only so old classes render, and their values are now gold and navy.

dos: Do use one primary button per area
Do put pages on the shell frame (--shell-max, --shell-gutter) and narrow reading pages to --shell-narrow
Do keep Traditional Chinese marks in Noto Serif TC with lang=zh-Hant
donts: Don't use the legacy button variants celadon, sage, terra, traditional or rice
